lesson.title: The Feynman technique
lesson.body: To check whether you really understand something, try to explain it in simple words to someone with no background in it. Where you reach for jargon or get stuck, you've found a gap. Go back to the source, fill the gap, and simplify your explanation again. Repeat until a twelve-year-old could follow it. The technique works for anything, from how vaccines work to why interest rates matter, because explaining forces you to organise what you know.
lesson.try_it: Pick one idea from today's front page and explain it out loud in under a minute.
